clauses.quote: teachers shall continue to escort their classes to and from the lavatory during the health period.
clauses.notes: Embedded in an exception clause within section 20.1.10.

clauses.quote: Educational aides and school assistants, who are assigned to the school, shall be scheduled to assist teachers with cafeteria and playground duty.
clauses.notes: Passive construction assigns implicit scheduling duty to management.

clauses.quote: Teachers will not be required to fill out any forms unless they are official DCPS forms or forms required by a government agency or forms devised jointly by SCAC and the Administration.
clauses.notes: Negated obligation functioning as a relief from duty; passive voice assigns implicit agent to management.
